column1: # MODES.tsv — the DECLARED grading mode per family. hq_C FORMAT RULING (TRIO 2026-08-29):
# DECLARED, NEVER DERIVED. A family absent from this file is UNKNOWN, which is UNPROVEN at
# grading time — never PASS, never FAIL — and is reported loudly by the builder.
# ⛔ Do NOT populate this by pattern-matching family names. The mode is a property of THE RUNNER;
# record what a runner actually does, with the runner named, or leave the family out.
# ⛔⭐ COLUMN 1 IS THE `family` COLUMN OF ALL.csv, NOT `origin` (hq_C 2026-09-05). read_modes_decl()
# keys on family, so an origin-shaped key matches NOTHING and declares NOTHING while reading, to any
# human opening the file, as a declaration. 37 of the 39 keys here were origin-shaped and therefore
# inert: the file claimed 39 declared families and bound 2. They are re-keyed below, each to the
# family its origin actually belongs to (ALL.csv, no renames involved, no conflicts).
# ⭐ AN ORPHANED KEY IS WORSE THAN AN ABSENT ONE. An absent family is UNKNOWN and says so; an
# orphaned key is UNKNOWN that looks answered, so nobody goes looking. util_build_master_suite.py
# now REPORTS every key that matches no family, which is why this can be seen at all.
